messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the kernel-autotune RFC review: when we get a mixed seq-len batch (e.g. [8, 32, 512]) and shape-hints are enabled, should the tuner prefer aligning small seqs into a packed micro-batch vs running them individually? I'm worried about prefill-induced KV cache churn.

josh: I think prefer packing up to a cost threshold. packing reduces kernel launch overhead but can blow KV cache locality. :thinking:

katie: short + precise: we need a heuristic: if median_seq_len <= 32 and p50 latency target < 50ms, pack; else don't. also consider memory headroom.

anand: +1 to cost-threshold. also add an eviction priority for prefilled KV: prefer evicting old prefix-only contexts before streaming contexts.

maria: proposal: introduce `shape_hint` enum (packed, aligned, conservative) passed to kernel tuner. default=aligned. packed -> batch small seqs into 1 kernel call, aligned -> pad to nearest bucket, conservative -> single-run.

devon: sounds good. how do we surface to serving? Env var? model config? runtime flag?

maria: model config override + global fallback. will add to rollout flags.

infra-bot: deploy queued: kernel-tuner/shape-hint feature-flag -> staging :rocket:

josh: edge-case: streaming + prefill: streaming requests expect incremental KV reuse. If we pack prefill with unrelated small reqs, KV mapping gets noisy. Suggest: don't pack prefill if any streaming request in batch.

katie: agree. add check: if has_streaming then force conservative.

anand: tuning metrics: add "cache-miss-rate" and "prefill-evictions/sec" to kernel telemetry. We need guardrails in optimizer to back off packing if evictions spike > X.

maria: implementation notes:
```
# pseudo
if has_streaming:
  shape_hint = "conservative"
elif median_seq_len < 48 and cache_headroom > 20%:
  shape_hint = "packed"
else:
  shape_hint = "aligned"
```

maria: I'll draft a short RFC patch and put perf tests (mixed seq lengths, streaming mix) in perf-suite. assigning @devon to add telemetry.

devon: on it. I'll add dashboard panels and a canary with 10% traffic.

katie: +1

maria: thanks all :tada:
